summary: Mergeable with minor issues: the patch is mostly correct, but could benefit from additional documentation and a more robust approach to handling VLAs.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor style inconsistency by changing the indentation of the elif block.
The patch uses a fragile approach to handling VLAs by relying on the specific format of the column, which may not be future-proof.
The patch does not include additional tests to cover the new VLA handling logic.
The patch could benefit from additional documentation to explain the changes and the reasoning behind them.
